verdicts.rationale: Different titles ("Effects of context of prior presentation" JEP:LMC vol 15, 1989 vs "A Dual-systems Theory" Mind & Language vol 5, 1990), different journals, years, and DOIs. Two distinct papers.

"Towards a model..." (1980, Canadian J Psych, DOI h0081031) vs "Further toward a model..." (1983, Bulletin of the Psychonomic Society, DOI bf03334699). Distinct follow-up paper: different year, journal, pages, DOI.

Both "Communication of emotions in vocal expression and music performance", Juslin & Laukka 2003, Psychological Bulletin 129, 770-814. B's title/publisher are corrupted with leaked citation metadata but it is the same work.
Both "From Discourse to Logic" by Kamp & Reyle 1993, Springer. B carries the full subtitle; same book.
Both "From Discourse to Logic" by Kamp & Reyle 1993, Springer. Same book, differently keyed.
Kaplan's "Quantifying In", same author and title. Appeared in Synthese 19 (1968) and reprinted in Words and Objections (1969); same intellectual work across the two venues.
"Presuppositions of/and Compound Sentences", Karttunen 1973, Linguistic Inquiry vol 4, pages 169-193. Same work.
"Some Relationships Between Body Motion and Speech", Kendon 1972, pages 177-210, in Studies in Dyadic Communication (Pergamon). Same work.
"Time course of the integration..." (2010, Vision Research 50, DOI 2010.08.012) vs "Attention-free integration..." (2012, Vision Research 65, DOI 2012.06.008). Different titles, years, volumes, DOIs.
Both "Microgenesis and Ontogenesis of Perceptual Organization", Kimchi/Hadad/Behrmann/Palmer 2005, Psychological Science vol 16(4), pp 282-290. Same work.
"Fact" by Kiparsky & Kiparsky, published in Progress in Linguistics (1970/1971). Same work; the two entries differ only in a 1-year date discrepancy and book/chapter typing.

The shared DOI (10.1080/01638539409544883) belongs to "Using linguistic phenomena to motivate a set of coherence relations" (Discourse Processes 1994). Entry a has a genuinely different title ("Discourse relations as descriptions of an algorithm...") — the DOI on a is erroneous/copied; two distinct Knott & Dale papers.
Part I ("Periodic target steps", pp 619-632, DOI 90238-4) vs Part II ("Single target displacements", pp 633-646, DOI 90239-6). Two-part series; distinct articles with different pages and DOIs.
Both "Foundations of measurement", Krantz/Luce/Suppes/Tversky 1971, Academic Press. Entry a has a garbled author list but is the same book.
Both "Foundations of measurement", Krantz et al. 1971, Academic Press. Same book (vol 1).
Both "Foundations of measurement", Krantz/Luce/Suppes/Tversky 1971, Academic Press. Same book (vol 1).

Both "How position dependent is visual object recognition?", Kravitz/Vinson/Baker 2008, Trends in Cognitive Sciences vol 12, pp 114-122. Same work; a has leaked journal text into its title/journal fields.

"The Semantics and Pragmatics of Weak and Strong Polarity Items in Assertions" (1994, SALT 4, pp 195-219, DOI salt.v4i0.2462) vs "The Semantics and Pragmatics of Polarity Items" (1995, Linguistic Analysis, pp 209-257). Two distinct Krifka papers: different venues, years, pages, titles.
"Speaker's Reference and Semantic Reference", Kripke 1979, University of Minnesota Press. Entry a's title is truncated to "Speaker"; same work.
"Women, Fire, and Dangerous Things", Lakoff 1987, University of Chicago Press. Entry b's title is truncated to "Women"; same book.
